groups.id: Live presence and session initial construction
groups.trace: Live mutation requires existing actor party/settlement, at least one persistent NPC, and actual personal clock (missing is error). Canonical place selected only after navigation. Fresh Core validated_venue_selection requires coarse settlement basis and exact same-settlement venue; are_co_present compares exact frontier and place. Start uses PairwiseSoft; fresh enforce_temporal_scope calls canonical_now and requires actor time, deliberately does not read/advance target clock. Actual player/NPC roles validated from embedded catalogue before construction. New session revision0 is intentional initial value. NPC role min>1 explicitly rejects; first binds requestedNPC, later chooses unused colocated NPC. It writes session/player before subsequent missing NPC/cardinality/presence errors, so outer transaction/catch evidence still required; no successful partial commit claimed. Existing session retry compares conversation/settlement/location/catalogue but omits requested npc_actor_id; require_live checks stored participant, not requested identity. Two valid NPCs with same conversation/place could therefore have same session retry silently retain original NPC; current source identifies immutable request equality question, not numeric operations defect or proved ordinary reachable pair.
groups.disposition: Clock fallback in dialogue_effects205 is not on this start/live path; preserve distinct caller evidence. Exact start retry and atomicity dependencies remain qualified.
